title: Meta shares jump more than 16% on solid earnings, stock buyback, and dividend plan - Yahoo Finance
snippet: S&P 500 Dow 30 Nasdaq Russell 2000 Crude Oil Gold Silver EUR/USD 10-Yr Bond GBP/USD USD/JPY Bitcoin USD CMC Crypto 200 FTSE 100 Nikkei 225 Meta stock jumps 20% on solid earnings, stock buyback, and dividend plan Meta Platforms (META) stock rocketed higher on Friday, climbing more than 20% after the company posted better-than-expected earnings and guidance and announced new shareholder return initiatives.  The division, which is tasked with turning Zuckerberg’s vision of the metaverse into a reality, lost another $4.65 billion, up from the $4.3 billion the company lost on the endeavor in the same period last year. For the latest earnings reports and analysis, earnings whispers and expectations, and company earnings news, click here Read the latest financial and business news from Yahoo Finance Related Quotes TRENDING The launch of Apple’s rival Vision Pro headset could create a jump in consumer interest in AR/VR headsets and generate a knock-on effect for Meta’s Quest line of headsets.  Meta has been on a hot streak over the last 12 months, with shares rocketing 121% over that period and outperforming the likes of Apple (AAPL), Google (GOOG, GOOGL), Microsoft (MSFT), and Amazon (AMZN).
